up: Retrieve IC50 activity values for compounds tested against the target 'Acetylcholinesterase' (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL220). For each activity record, return the compound's canonical SMILES structure and the PubMed ID or DOI of the source publication. Do not filter by unit or confidence score. Return all matching rows.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL220' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
